title: 🪐 Saturn's Rings | Space for Kids
description:
Everything you wondered about Saturn's Rings! A calm, playful space journey made for little explorers.

🚀 In this episode:
• Saturn is a huge planet far from the Sun
• Those rings are not made of stone
• Some ice pieces are as small as dust
• Saturn has many moons
• A spacecraft named Cassini visited Saturn for many years and sent us photographs

👶 Made for children aged 4-8.
🔭 Imagery comes from NASA's public domain archive.
